title: Novitiate

inlines.v: NOVI'TIATE, noun 1. The state or time or learning rudiments. 2. In religious houses, a year or other time of probation for the trial of a noveice, to determine whether he has the necessary qualities for living up to the rule to which his vow is to bind him.
